roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs while also leading our infection control initiatives. We are looking for a proactive and knowledgeable professional to contribute to our team's excellence and maintain regulatory compliance. This is an urgent opening, and we are actively interviewing candidates.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection prevention and staff education
Excellent communication and organizational skills

description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This confidential role is with a recently purchased facility, offering a unique chance to make a significant impact and contribute to its continued success. We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to drive marketing initiatives and enhance community presence.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive and presentable individual with a proven track record in healthcare marketing. This role requires a commitment to working occasional weekends to meet business needs. We offer competitive compensation for the right person, recognizing the value of a dedicated and effective leader in this pivotal position.
requirements: Professional demeanor and strong presentation skills.
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives.
Minimum of 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential speech and language services to patients, contributing significantly to their recovery and well-being. We are looking for a compassionate professional ready to make an immediate impact.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role. Additionally, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available for qualified candidates. If you are passionate about patient care and looking for a flexible PRN opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to work on a PRN basis
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows you to provide essential therapy services, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing individualized treatment plans, working collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal patient outcomes.

This role offers the flexibility of a PRN schedule, perfect for professionals seeking to balance work with other commitments. You will enjoy a supportive environment focused on patient-centered care and professional growth. We are looking for a motivated individual eager to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $39.00 - $40.00 based on experience.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional care and improving the quality of life for our residents. We are seeking passionate and skilled Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA), Occupational Therapists (OT), and Speech Therapists (ST) to become a vital part of our dynamic therapy team. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals looking to make a significant impact in a supportive and collaborative environment. We offer flexible full-time and part-time positions, allowing you to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle while contributing to a facility renowned for its patient-centered approach. You will work alongside a dedicated team of healthcare professionals, utilizing your expertise to develop and implement individualized treatment plans that promote recovery and independence. If you are a dedicated therapy professional eager to contribute your skills to a facility committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply. This role provides a chance to grow professionally and personally within a rewarding healthcare setting.
requirements: Valid state license/certification as a COTA, PTA, OT, or ST in Florida
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility is preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to develop and implement effective therapy plans
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA roles ranges from $28.00 - $37.00/hr. Compensation for PT/OT/ST roles ranges from $40.00 - $46.00/hr.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated School Psychologist for a contract position within a reputable school district in Colorado Springs, CO. This role offers an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on student well-being and academic success, providing essential psychological services to students across various grade levels.

In this role, you will be responsible for conducting assessments, developing and implementing interventions, and collaborating with educators, parents, and administrators to foster a supportive learning environment. This initial contract runs for 42 weeks, starting July 27, 2026, offering a competitive hourly rate of $60/hr+.
requirements: Master's or Doctoral degree in School Psychology
Colorado Department of Education (CDE) Special Services Provider License with School Psychologist endorsement
Experience working with school-aged children and adolescents
Knowledge of relevant educational laws and regulations (e.g., IDEA, Section 504)
Strong assessment, intervention, and consultation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $60 per hour, with an initial contract term of 42 weeks, beginning July 27, 2026.
